_about: The item catalogue: everyday equipment, magic items, gems, trade goods and Pallimustus's own goods. Prices are in gp (1 iron spirit coin = 1 gp). 'rarity' sets where an item can be found: see 'settlements'. 'rank' marks world goods made for a rank. Under 'settlements', maxRarity and maxPrice cap what shops sell, essenceMax caps essences, 'ranks' weights the rank of essences, stones and cores, and 'auction' says whether auction houses are found there. 'places' says which kind of settlement each wiki location is, and 'placeMagic' how much magic it has: in a low-magic place rare goods turn up half as often and high-rank goods are scarce ('magicLevels'). Add your own items here and they appear in the Items browser and in markets.

low.label: Low magic
low.note: Low magic: high-magic goods are scarce, and costly to keep powered.

items.name: Universal solvent
items.desc: Dissolves any adhesive, even sovereign glue.

items.name: Sphere of annihilation
items.desc: A floating sphere of nothing that destroys whatever it touches.

items.name: Talisman of pure good
items.desc: A holy symbol that can open fissures to swallow evil.

items.name: Talisman of ultimate evil
items.desc: An unholy symbol that can destroy the good.

items.name: Talisman of the sphere
items.desc: Lets you control a sphere of annihilation.

items.name: Well of many worlds
items.desc: A black cloth circle that opens a portal to another world.

items.name: Orb of dragonkind
items.desc: One of a few ancient orbs holding the essence of an evil dragon. Priceless, and never truly owned.

items.name: Essence case
items.desc: A padded, warded box for carrying an unabsorbed essence. Its ward hides the essence from anyone sensing for magic.

items.name: Awakening stone tray
items.desc: A felt-lined wooden tray with slots for twelve awakening stones.

items.name: Warded coin purse
items.desc: A purse that hums when another hand opens it.

items.name: Core lamp
items.desc: A lamp that burns an Iron core for a month of steady light.

items.name: Core stove
items.desc: A small stove that cooks and heats a room on one Iron core a week.

items.name: Surge bell
items.desc: A bell that rings by itself when the ambient magic thickens before a monster surge.

items.name: Dimensional satchel (Iron)
items.desc: Holds 100 pounds in a space far bigger inside than out. Made for Iron-rank adventurers.

items.name: Dimensional bag (Bronze)
items.desc: Holds 1,000 pounds. A Bronze-rank storage item.

items.name: Storage ring (Silver)
items.desc: A ring with a room-sized space inside. Only Silver-rank crafters can make one.

items.name: Stamina tonic
items.desc: Removes one level of exhaustion.

items.name: Marsh fever cure
items.desc: A bitter tea that ends marsh fever in a day.

items.name: Ritual chalk
items.desc: Chalk ground with spirit-coin dust, for drawing ritual circles.

items.name: Ritual circle kit
items.desc: Chalk, cord, candles and a folding guide for the most common ritual circles, including essence absorption.

items.name: Suppression manacles
items.desc: Manacles that stop the wearer from using essence abilities. Crown and Society issue only, officially.

items.name: Cloud-flask
items.desc: A flask of shaped cloud that unfolds into a solid 10-foot platform for an hour.

items.name: Translation earring
items.desc: You understand any spoken language. Popular with outworlders.

items.name: Monster-hide coat (Iron)
items.desc: Light armour of Iron-rank monster hide. AC 12 + Dex modifier, and it repairs small tears overnight.

items.name: Monster-scale armour (Bronze)
items.desc: Medium armour of Bronze-rank monster scales. AC 15 + Dex modifier (max 2), no Stealth disadvantage.

items.name: Iron-rank monster blood (vial)
items.desc: An alchemical reagent for potions and rituals.

items.name: Bronze-rank monster ichor (vial)
items.desc: A potent reagent that only Bronze-rank alchemists can work.

items.name: Astral space map
items.desc: A map marking the entrance to a known astral space, and what's been seen inside.

items.name: Local monster almanac
items.desc: The Adventure Society's notes on monsters of the region, what they drop, and how they die.

items.name: Contract board copy
items.desc: Today's Adventure Society contracts, copied by hand.

items.name: Adventure Society badge
items.desc: Issued free to members; shows rank. Not sold, and forging one is a crime.

items.name: Core-powered carriage
items.desc: A carriage that runs without horses on a Bronze core a week.

items.name: Warding talisman
items.desc: Once a day, as a reaction, gain resistance to damage from a monster's attack.

items.name: Spirit-coin tea
items.desc: Tea brewed with a pinch of coin dust. Counts as a meal for an essence user.

items.name: Self-warming cloak
items.desc: Keeps you comfortable in cold weather.

items.name: Everburning lamp-stone
items.desc: A stone that glows like a lantern, forever.
